subject: Barry workspace filtering
object: an optional docs/context/workspaces.json registry that maps workspace slugs to titles, aliases, owned paths, canonical feature routes, and dependencies while keeping docs/context feature packs as the single canonical memory store

subject: workspace selection
object: explicit --workspace first, then --paths path inference, then task text inference, then no workspace; selected workspace routes receive a route/search boost, dependency routes receive a smaller boost, and unrelated global matches remain visible

subject: resume workspace ambiguity
object: workspace_decision.status ambiguous with candidates and required_action instead of a context preview when the default require-when-ambiguous policy cannot choose a single workspace

subject: barry-cache workspace
object: list and infer subcommands, and route/search/resume accept --workspace and --paths workspace hints that surface the structured workspace_decision in JSON output

subject: barry-cache validate
object: optional workspace registry shape, duplicate slugs, duplicate aliases, unknown routes, unknown dependencies, self-dependencies, invalid selection mode, no-match workspace paths, and recursive wildcard path prefixes without false no-match warnings; context-cache manifests also watch workspaces.json and the workspace schema

subject: Generated Barry agent instructions
object: pass --paths when relevant files or directories are known, use Barry's selected workspace, and not guess when workspace_decision.status is ambiguous; agents should ask the user or rerun with --workspace <slug>
